dataset.description: Dataset comprising measured and modelled indoor environmental parameters (thermal conditions and indoor air quality) collected in micro and small spaces to support analysis, model validation, and development of comfort and ventilation recommendations.

distribution.title:
The purpose of the data collection and data generation is to obtain an empirical and model-ready evidence base for understanding and improving thermal comfort and indoor air quality in micro and small spaces. Concretely, the data are collected to
  1. characterise the temporal and spatial variability of key indoor environmental parameters under realistic occupancy and ventilation conditions, 
  2. quantify relationships between controllable factors (e.g., ventilation rate, air distribution, heat gains, moisture sources) and outcomes relevant to comfort and exposure, 
  3. calibrate, validate, and compare simulation or reduced-order models used to predict conditions in constrained volumes, and 
  4. support the derivation and verification of practical recommendations for design and operation that balance comfort, health protection, and energy use.

dataset.title: PhD thesis "Ensuring thermal comfort and indoor air quality in micro and small spaces" data

dmp.description: The PhD thesis “Ensuring thermal comfort and indoor air quality in micro and small spaces” examines how thermal conditions and air pollutant exposure develop in highly compact indoor environments where limited volume, high occupant density, and restricted ventilation can amplify discomfort and health risks. The work aims to quantify these dynamics through measurements and modelling, and to derive practical design and operational strategies (ventilation control, air distribution solutions, and low-energy conditioning approaches) that maintain acceptable thermal comfort and indoor air quality while respecting the specific constraints of micro- and small-scale spaces.
